phonetically_fragile_spans.why: alphanumeric ids mis-recognise in noisy audio
spoken dates collapse across similar-sounding numbers

observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.
Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.
Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

rules.name: No clinical advice
rules.rule: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.

rules.name: Slot truth
rules.rule: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.

rules.name: Registration first
rules.rule: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.

rules.name: Fee disclosure
rules.rule: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.

forbidden_actions: Offering any clinical opinion or triage judgement.
Quoting a slot or fee no tool returned.

rules.name: No approval promise
rules.rule: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.

rules.name: Network gate
rules.rule: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.

rules.name: Balance truth
rules.rule: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.

rules.name: Waiting period
rules.rule: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

forbidden_actions: Stating or implying that pre-authorisation will be approved.
Offering cashless at a non-network hospital.
Quoting a payable amount no tool result supports.

book_appointment.purpose: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

check_doctor_availability.purpose: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

estimate_procedure_cost.purpose: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

lookup_patient_record.purpose: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

lookup_policy_coverage.purpose: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

submit_preauth_request.purpose: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

appointment_scheduling.purpose: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
appointment_scheduling.business_context: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

terminal_success_conditions: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.
Patient told no slot exists in the window and offered the next step.
escalation_conditions: Caller describes symptoms suggesting an emergency.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

insurance_preauth.purpose: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.
insurance_preauth.business_context: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

terminal_success_conditions: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
Patient told why cashless is unavailable and what the alternative is.
escalation_conditions: Patient disputes the policy terms the insurer returned.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
